Labs \u2014 Be\u0394LivingWater / Citadel","details":"DESIGN CONTRACT (read before changing anything)  1. The gate never computes risk. The off-chain Citadel engine remains the single source of     truth. The gate's only job is to make \"bypass the engine\" unreachable on-chain.  2. Fail-closed by construction. There is no code path that executes on a missing, stale,     malformed, replayed or non-ALLOW attestation. `halted` denies everything.  3. No oracle reads. Sequencer uptime, oracle lag and price impact are observed off-chain and     sealed into the signature. This is deliberate: Arbitrum Orbit chains (e.g. Robinhood Chain)     have no Chainlink feeds, so an on-chain feed dependency would make the gate undeployable     there. The attestation model keeps one implementation valid across every Arbitrum chain.  4. Immutable. No proxy, no `delegatecall`, no upgrade path, no ETH custody. A new version is a     new address. This removes the entire proxy/storage-collision vulnerability class.  5. Time uses `block.timestamp` only. On Arbitrum `block.number` returns an approximation of the     *L1* block height (L2 height is `ArbSys(0x64).arbBlockNumber()`), so block-count logic is a     silent footgun. `block.timestamp` is sequencer-set with bounded drift, which MAX_FUTURE_SKEW     tolerates explicitly.  6. Asymmetric authority. Tightening (halt) is immediate. Loosening (unhalt, adding a signer,     lowering the threshold) is timelocked. A stolen guardian key can only stop the system \u2014     which is the safe direction.  7. MAX_TTL = 30s mirrors the engine's 30-second Oracle Lag Shield. It also means that after a     sequencer outage every pre-outage attestation is already dead, so recovery cannot be flooded     with stale authorisations.ECDSA is implemented inline rather than imported. For a ~200-line safety-critical contract,      zero third-party dependencies is a smaller total attack surface than one library import. params.initialSigners: Strictly ascending, non-zero, unique. Ascending order is enforced so        that duplicates are impossible to smuggle in at deployment.

proposeAdmin(address).details: Pull pattern: the proposal alone changes nothing, so a typo cannot brick the role.

proposeSignerChange(address,bool,uint8).details: Both directions are timelocked. Removing a signer looks like tightening but can be used      to strand the engine, so it gets the same delay as adding one.

verifyAndConsume((bytes32,address,uint8,.details: The digest is marked consumed BEFORE this function returns and therefore before any      caller-side external interaction (checks-effects-interactions). Without that ordering a      re-entrant executor could reuse a live attestation within one transaction.

ACTION_PASS_GREENLIGHT().notice: Dune telemetry action codes — mirrors off-chain `evaluatePendleGmxCrossGuard`.

MAX_FUTURE_SKEW().notice: Tolerated forward clock skew of the sequencer relative to the engine.

MAX_SIGNATURES().notice: Upper bound on signatures per call. Bounds the verification loop.

MAX_TTL().notice: Maximum attestation lifetime. Mirrors the engine's 30s Oracle Lag Shield.

SIGNER_TIMELOCK().notice: Delay before a proposed signer-set change can execute.

UNHALT_DELAY().notice: Delay before a scheduled unhalt can execute (loosening ⇒ timelocked).

VERDICT_ALLOW().notice: ALLOW is the only accepted verdict. Any other value denies.

admin().notice: May schedule loosening actions. All of them are timelocked.

cancelSignerChange().notice: Guardian may cancel a pending loosening proposal without waiting.

checkAttestation((bytes32,address,uint8,.notice: Non-mutating dry run. Returns bytes4(0) when the attestation would be accepted,         otherwise the error selector that `verifyAndConsume` would revert with.

guardian().notice: May halt at any time. Cannot loosen anything.

halt().notice: Immediate kill switch. Intentionally the only un-timelocked authority in the gate.

pendingChange().notice: At most one pending signer-set change. Deliberate: one thing to audit at a time.

proposeSignerChange(address,bool,uint8).notice: Propose adding or removing a signing key, together with the resulting threshold.

unhaltEta().notice: Earliest timestamp at which `executeUnhalt` may run. 0 = not scheduled.
